content: {"reasoning":"Prior authorization is required and missing, and this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review; attaching records would not resolve the authorization deficiency. No denial or information request exists to support an appeal or requested-information response, and the deductible alone does not establish patient liability for an unauthorized service. Escalation is appropriate because no available routine action can properly advance the claim without clarification of a permissible recovery path or write-off disposition.","action":"escalate"}
